newsitem.title: FINLAND: Wary Finnish shares retreat ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Wary Finnish shares retreat ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Shares failed to hold early gains on Monday as uncertaintly ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting prompted profit-taking on an otherwise eventless market , brokers said.
The policy-setting meeting to start on Tuesday was widely expected to hold interest rates but sentiment was shaky and the HEX general index fell 0.52 percent to close at 2,762.77 points.
Bourse engine Nokia outperformed the HEX, starting the session higher but eventually losing 0.31 percent to 323.00 markka. Nokia accounted for over half of total 706 million markka trade.
Consumer goods maker Hackman rose 2.00 markka to 126.00 on its plans to sell its techno-chemicals unit to German chemicals group Henkel.
Shipping group Finnlines rose in active trade ahead of its 1996 report due on Friday, ending 3.20 markka higher at 125.20.
Forestries fell after sharp losses in U.S. paper stocks, with the sub-index down 1.05 percent. UPM-Kymmene was active, down almost 2.5 percent to 100.00 markka.
"Forestries are falling since we have only had bad news from the industry recently," said one broker.

Engineering group Santasalo-JOT continued to rise on last week's acquisition of Asko's cast component unit and stone fireplace maker Tulikivi extended gains on the back of its strong 1996 report. Santasalo closed up 2.50 markka at 58.50 and Tulikivi soared 8.00 markka to 79.00.
Cultor was unchanged in modest trade at 246 markka ahead of its preliminary 1996 results due on Tuesday.
